title: Device-run result (one file per model x device)
description: Measured on-device behavior of one model on one physical device, one record per accelerator (x prompt-length condition, see results) attempted — deliberately parallel to sweep_result.schema.json. Covers BOTH Phase 13 lanes: .tflite models on NPU accelerators (env.runtime = litert) and .litertlm bundles on LiteRT-LM (env.runtime = litert-lm). Model-level results only: op-level matrix entries are NEVER derived from these records (the trap rule, device edition) — op-level entries require a runtime log naming the specific op, captured as evidence, or an npu_adb probe result. Snapshot layout: data/device_runs/<runtime_version>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<model_id>__<device>.json, append-only; every record in one snapshot directory must carry the same env.runtime and an env.runtime_version equal to the directory's version segment. Every record carries its full env block; a record without env is invalid — results are only ever presented with the environment that produced them.

model_id.description: Catalog id (the cards/ id where a card exists). Together with `device` it names this file: <model_id>__<device>.json.

device.description: Device slug used in this file's name (lowercase, no underscores — the filename separator is '__'). The human-readable device name lives in env.device.

artifact.description: The exact artifact measured (e.g. gemma3-1b-it-int4.litertlm), as named by the measurement log. Artifacts are never committed to this repo.

artifact_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact bytes measured, when a primary source states it (the ship's upload log, the curated manifest, or the hosting API read at ship time) — verbatim, never hand-computed from a file that might not be the measured one. Absent/null = not recorded; a Hub file replaced after the measurement date then cannot be told apart from the measured one by name alone (DECISIONS #167).

quantization.description: Quantization variant (e.g. int4, int8). Owner-supplied; adapters never infer it from file names — null when not stated by the source.

results.description: One record per (accelerator x prompt-length condition) attempted, sorted by accelerator id then metrics.prefill_tokens. Two records may share an accelerator when their metrics.prefill_tokens differ: throughput is conditional on prompt length, so those are different facts, not re-measurements.

accelerator.description: The accelerator attempted: a registered backend id (npu_qnn, npu_neuropilot, gpu_mldrift, cpu_xnnpack, ...) or the runtime's own accelerator name (litert-lm: gpu, cpu, npu).

loads.description: The model loaded / the engine was created for this accelerator. When false, failure_class and error say why.

runs.description: At least one inference (or generate call) completed AND produced output. A benchmark that prints a results block with zero throughput did NOT run — zero throughput is a failure marker, not a measurement.

failure_class.description: Machine-usable failure class when loads or runs is false. Known classes: engine_create_failed (delegate/compiler rejected the graph at engine creation), zero_throughput (a results block was printed but every generate call failed), load_failed, run_error, timeout, device_error. Open set — consumers must tolerate unknown values.

error.description: Verbatim primary diagnostic line of a load/run failure.

full_delegation.description: Whether the whole graph ran on the accelerator. null when the source states nothing (a passing litert-lm benchmark log does not say); false when the log states a split, with delegated_ops/total_ops when the log gives counts.

delegated_ops.description: Operations the runtime log says ran on the accelerator (e.g. '536 operations will run on the GPU'). null when the log states no count.

total_ops.description: Total operations per the same log line (delegated + remaining). null when the log states no count.

output_match.description: Numerical comparison against the CPU reference on the same inputs (shared tolerance policy). null when the source performed no such comparison — a loadability sanity check (compat_check's fixed-question answer) is evidence, not a numeric comparison.

max_abs_diff.description: max |out - ref| across compared elements. null whenever output_match is null.

max_rel_diff.description: max |out - ref| / max(|ref|, 1e-9) across compared elements. null whenever output_match is null.

latency_p50_ms.description: Median single-inference latency in ms (CV lane). null for the LLM lane, whose cost model is prefill/decode throughput.

prefill_tokens_per_s.description: LLM lane: prefill throughput. null for the CV lane and for failed runs (a printed 0.00 is a failure marker, never a measurement).

decode_tokens_per_s.description: LLM lane: decode throughput. null for the CV lane and for failed runs.

ttft_ms.description: LLM lane: time to first token in ms. null when the source does not measure it.

peak_mem_mb.description: DEVICE-MEASURED peak memory only. An estimated figure (devicemark mem_measured: false) must never land here — carry it as metrics.peak_mem_est_mb instead.

context_length.description: LLM lane: context length tested, only when the source states one explicitly. The benchmark's prefill/decode/max-token counts are facts of their own and live in metrics.

signature.description: CV lane: the signature (subgraph) this record measured, for multi-signature .tflite files where each signature is a different measurement (e.g. decode / prefill_128, encode / decode_1, transcribe_10s). Part of the record's identity (record_label). null/absent = the file's single or default signature.

metrics.description: Open map of additional numeric facts stated by the source, e.g. init_s, prefill_tokens, decode_tokens, max_num_tokens, peak_mem_est_mb (explicitly-estimated memory), power_w.

evidence.description: Verbatim runtime-log excerpts backing this record: unsupported-op lines, partition counts, error traces, results blocks, source rows. May be empty only when the record claims nothing beyond loads/runs.

date.description: Measurement date. Sources that do not stamp one require the owner to supply it — never inferred from file mtimes by tooling.

provenance.description: example = synthetic pipeline fixture; never mistake for a real device measurement. measured = a real model measured on the recorded env.

env.description: Mandatory on every record: results are only ever presented with the environment that produced them. Fields a source does not carry are explicit nulls supplied knowingly — never silently invented values.

soc.description: SoC name; null when the source does not record it.

runtime.description: Which runtime executed the model: litert (.tflite lane) or litert-lm (.litertlm lane). Selects the staleness axis in data/releases.json (litert vs litertlm).

runtime_version.description: Version of that runtime. Must equal the snapshot directory's version segment.

vendor_sdk.description: Vendor SDK name + version for NPU runs (e.g. 'QNN SDK 2.x'); null where none applies (CPU/GPU) or the source does not record it.

os_build.description: OS build (Android build id / macOS version); null when the source does not record it.

machine_label.description: Owner-chosen label for the measuring machine (results are his-hardware-his-label).
